name: Rascal Turns You Into a Cute Furry Shortstack
source:
Bad end!!
Rascal caught you! She seems rather fond of you, brave pizza delivery girl that you are. Now she's gotta decide what kind of cartoon animal shortstack to turn you into based on your behavior and personality.

[From [url=https://fuyumochiru.itch.io/rascal-shortstack-tf-game]itch.io[/url]]
